scope.definition: Every materialized episodes[] dossier of the two campaigns that carry full dossier sources. episodeSelection[] and episodeBlueprints[] are never counted as dossiers.

discriminator.rule: An absent designProfile selects the legacy v2 contract shape; the explicit value alternative-fulfillment-v3 selects the alternative-fulfillment v3 shape. Both shapes are analysed on their own terms and v3 is never stripped or lowered to v2.

checkDefinitions.initial-actor-position-collision: Two or more authored actors that share an explicit initial hub and offset. The overlap is exact in authored tile coordinates; native body footprints are not certified, so the native outcome stays unknown and proximity is never reported as proved obstruction.
checkDefinitions.main-relief-corridor-geometry: Comparison of the authored main and relief corridors by explicit points when both exist, otherwise by the authored hub sequence. Different movement modes are distinguished. A missing alternate polyline is recorded as an authored-geometry gap, not as proof of failed native pathfinding.
checkDefinitions.authored-building-at-receiving-centre: Authored buildings and service outputs measured against the authored receiving circles. A finding requires the explicit distance from the building to the authored receiving-circle centre to be less than or equal to the authored receiving radius, which is what defines reception. The authored hub radius is activity geography and never creates a finding; the unknown native footprint of a building that stands outside the receiving circle is recorded separately and is not counted.
checkDefinitions.initial-spendable-versus-payments: Initial spendable stocks against the direct mandatory and optional payment totals of each difficulty profile, read from the objective predicates themselves and cross-checked against the declared summary vectors. Protected recovery and optional payout reserves are kept separate. A negative no-gathering margin is conditional because the authored finite gathering bank may legitimately fund the cost, and an optional reward is never treated as mandatory funding.
checkDefinitions.worker-cap-without-placed-roster: Numeric worker caps that have no explicit placed-worker roster. A cap is not a roster and does not prove that worker units exist.
checkDefinitions.repeated-role-phrase: Optional objective sentences in which the role noun that the template introduces occurs more than once, such as 'trader of ... trader'. The source text is quoted with its pointer and a small bilingual alternative is suggested. A label that merely carries the role noun once, without a repeated sentence, is recorded as an observation and not as a finding.

dispositionVocabulary.design-risk: The authored data contains a self-contradictory or duplicated design signal.
dispositionVocabulary.needs-physical-binding: The authored data is internally consistent but has no certified physical or native binding yet; the native outcome is unknown.
dispositionVocabulary.conditional-budget: The arithmetic depends on authored gathering or on an authored choice, so the negative margin is conditional rather than a failure.
dispositionVocabulary.editorial-candidate: A wording candidate for the architect to accept or reject.

limits: Documentary triage of authored data only. No finding is a game failure, a balance verdict or a playability approval.

The civic difficulty audit's 54 static risk candidates measure a different property and are not reused here.
The catalogue metrics 64 dossiers, 214 pending selections, 2645 screens and 398 secondary objectives are unchanged by this inventory.
No historical claim, citation or voice is introduced by this inventory.
